headword: {弘法|こうぼう}にも{筆|ふで}の{誤|あやま}り
reading: こうぼうにもふでのあやまり

definitions.gloss: even experts make mistakes; even Homer nods
definitions.explanation: Literally "even Kōbō Daishi makes slips of the brush". Kōbō Daishi (Kūkai) was famed as one of the greatest calligraphers, so the proverb says that even a master sometimes errs.

examples.japanese: {弘法|こうぼう}にも{筆|ふで}の{誤|あやま}りだ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Even experts make mistakes, don't they.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{弘法|こうぼう}にも{筆|ふで}の{誤|あやま}りだ。
examples.english: For a veteran like him to miscalculate, well, even experts slip up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えた→書き間違える：21977_kakimachigaeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{弘法|こうぼう}にも{筆|ふで}の{誤|あやま}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わなかった→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: The teacher wrote a kanji wrong, but as they say, even experts make mistakes, so nobody laughed.

notes:
{弘法|こうぼう} is ⟦{弘法大師|こうぼうだいし}→弘法大師：33240_kouboudaishi⟧, the posthumous title of the monk Kūkai (774–835), founder of Shingon Buddhism and a legendary calligrapher.

USAGE:
Said kindly about a skilled person's slip, often to console them. Using it about oneself can sound boastful, since it compares one to a master.
